## Review Depth

dependency, migration, workflow, release, protected-lane, current Scient seam,
and test inspection. The 2,831-addition/2,245-deletion remote-update commit was

## Ranked Intake Decision

1. `0ad91b6e` branch-drift reconciliation is the only current T3 code candidate
   with a confirmed Scient gap and durable user benefit. It is not selected now
   because open draft PR #182 and active operation-authority worktrees overlap
   its required orchestration schema and decider, making ownership ambiguous.
2. `d3037064` is the strongest engineering lesson, but it is an entire protected
   cloud/systemd updater architecture that Scient does not have. It cannot enter
   the fast lane and is retained only as design evidence.
3. `5192f777` is excellent but has no Scient destination seam.
4. `78eb3eca` and `283c7ac4` are visual/donor-identity changes with no current
   Scient product fit and are rejected.

## Intake Decision

No T3 commit is implemented. The branch-drift concept is recommended after the
active orchestration lane clears and after the exact current main seam is
rechecked. The remote-update commit is learn-only. The visual, identity, and
managed-relay changes are rejected as current intake.

No T3 branch, canonical checkout, writable remote, migration, credential model,
cloud service, updater/release authority, mobile surface, UI asset, or donor
automation is adopted.
